answer: A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 316 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. The whisper graph is validated at intake and the ripple frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and pearl anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A 223 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
